description: This file defines two test collection classes used in unit testing with the xUnit framework. The classes specify shared fixtures for testing an Orleans cluster environment, facilitating performance optimization and environment consistency across tests.

classes.name: DefaultClusterTestCollection
classes.description: Defines a test collection for tests that require a default Orleans cluster setup, sharing a single cluster instance for performance.

classes.name: TestEnvironmentFixtureCollection
classes.description: Defines a test collection for tests requiring shared environment configuration, managing internal Orleans test environment setup.
